name: Multi-Isosurface Visualization
definition: A technique for rendering multiple isosurfaces with different opacities concurrently by maintaining one Matryoshka layer per isosurface and processing corresponding planes across all layers together.
summary: Multi-Isosurface Visualization recombines multiple isosurface segments into a single scene, distinguishing itself by using separate layers and a unified auxiliary buffer to enforce global front-to-back ordering.
